title: JOVRA Room v1 shared definitions
description: Shared $defs for the JOVRA Room v1 contracts (session room, invitations, commands, receipts and the paired-watch bridge). Proposal status: no transport has been implemented or exercised. Freshness is always receiver-derived; no record here lets a sender assert that it is fresh.

id.description: Opaque identifier: letters, digits, '_' and '-' only (same rule as Studio ids), so an id can never be a path, URL or command.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 (key fingerprints, token hashes).

hmacSha256.description: Lower-case hex HMAC-SHA256 proof of possession.

secretToken.description: Unpadded base64url secret of at least 128 bits (22 characters) and at most 256 bits (43 characters). Appears only in a QR payload: never persisted in a record, never logged.

dateTime.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with a Z suffix. Wall-clock time is informational across devices; only the device that wrote it may compare against it (for example the host checking its own invitation expiry).

sample.description: True for fictional demo data, which every surface badges 'Sample'.

hostEpoch.description: Incremented on every host election or recovery. A previous epoch is never fresh authority.

revision.description: Authoritative event-log revision on the host.

captureState.description: A camera's own reported state. 'Unknown' is deliberately absent: it is a receiver-derived freshness result, never a sender's assertion.

captureRole.description: primary = the baseline analysis source (one per room); camera = an additional consenting recording phone; none = a participant that does not record (scorer phone, coach).

commandRole.description: Write privilege in the room. Pairing a watch grants nothing: a watch acts with its participant's granted role.

freshness.description: Receiver-derived only: Fresh (age <= freshMaxMs), Delayed (<= delayedMaxMs), Unknown (older, transit unbounded, or monotonic baseline lost).

deviceResultStatus.description: Per-target outcome of a capture request fan-out. Kept individually; never collapsed into one success banner.

provenanceLabel.description: Same values as the core provenanceStatus (spec/schemas/common.schema.json, ADR-0004); displayed as Manual / Estimated / Reviewed / Validated.

displayCode.description: Six-character human code shown beside a QR (e.g. JVR-482). Lookup data only: never an authentication secret. Same pattern as Studio's camera-invite displayCode.

studioSlot.description: Studio Build-your-match placement; must equal spec/schemas/studio/studio-common.schema.json#/$defs/placementSlot (drift-checked by scripts/spec/validate_room.py).

userText.description: A participant's own claim (e.g. a device name). Display only; never the basis of identity or approval.

freshnessPolicy.description: Proposed foreground defaults to benchmark, not OS scheduling guarantees.

capabilities.description: What the room can deliver in this session. v1 never delivers live serve speed or automated line calls.

serveSpeedResults.description: Phone-produced, post-capture serve-speed results (capability serveSpeed.manualAssisted) may be forwarded with their age and point. Not live.

scoreSummary.description: Derived from the authoritative point-event log at eventRevision (ADR-0003). Display only; a watch never edits it.

roster.description: The host's enrolled camera ids at a roster revision. It changes only with a higher rosterRevision (an approved join or a departure). Receivers count enrolment from the roster, never from the rows that happen to be present: an enrolled camera with no row is Unknown.

sourceRef.description: Where evidence lives: a device's capture instance and segment, optionally a frame range on that segment.
